clue.text: County players directed towards ground

parts.note: Down is a county of Northern Ireland
the cast is the set of actors in a play

explanation.surface: A team from one of the counties heads for its home pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'directed towards ground' looks like a description of the players' travel, but it is the definition: eyes cast down.
explanation.definitionFit: Downcast eyes are lowered, pointed at the floor, so the word means looking towards the ground.

clue.text: Lack of reverence, in particular after 500 lives taken

indicators.note: after puts the particular word behind the number and the verb

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
is means exists or lives
a respect is a particular point, as in 'in this respect'

explanation.surface: Disrespect, in this case, after five hundred people were killed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken' and 'in' are link words; 'lives taken' suggests deaths, but lives is IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Disrespect is the absence of proper esteem, a want of reverence.

clue.text: How to get wife with love and ring?

definitions.text: How to get wife with love and ring?

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
a ring is round, shaped like O

explanation.surface: A question about winning a bride with affection and an engagement ring.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: you court a wife with love and a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: To woo is to court someone in the hope of marriage.

clue.text: Jazz fan with Charlie Parker and American singer

parts.note: cat is jazz slang for a fan or musician
Bird was the nickname of jazz saxophonist Charlie Parker

explanation.surface: A jazz enthusiast hangs out with Charlie Parker and a US vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'singer' suggests a human vocalist, but it is a songbird.
explanation.definitionFit: The catbird is a North American songbird, named for its mewing call, so it is an American singer.

clue.text: Pole protects North Sea port

parts.note: the South Pole is one of the two poles
shields means protects

explanation.surface: A Polish sailor guards a harbour on the North Sea.
explanation.walkthrough: SOUTH SHIELDS is a port town in north-east England at the mouth of the Tyne.
explanation.definitionFit: South Shields is a coastal town on the Tyne estuary facing the North Sea.

clue.text: Appeal to deflect deity

parts.note: SA is short for sex appeal
to deflect something is to turn it aside

explanation.surface: Someone pleads in an attempt to turn aside a god's wrath.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturn was the Roman god of agriculture and time, so he is a deity.

clue.text: Exemplary comrade a Conservative detests

parts.note: hates means detests

explanation.surface: A model friend whom a Tory loathes.
explanation.definitionFit: In Virgil's Aeneid, faithful Achates was Aeneas's loyal companion, a byword for a true friend.

clue.text: Creating stress at home, when minion's around

indicators.note: around tells us the minion wraps round the home word

parts.note: an underling is a minion, a lowly subordinate
in means at home

explanation.surface: Tension builds in the house whenever the lackey is about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' suggests anxiety, but it is emphasis, as when a word is underlined.
explanation.definitionFit: Underlining a word gives it emphasis, so it means placing stress on it.

clue.text: Information partners provided about their opponents

indicators.note: about tells us the partners go around the opponents

parts.note: in bridge, North and South are partners
in bridge, East and West oppose North and South

explanation.surface: Some couples give reports about their rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: This turns on the bridge table, where N and S partner against E and W.
explanation.definitionFit: News is fresh information about recent events.

clue.text: Removal of most locks is a time-saver

definitions.meaning: a drastic haircut taking off most of the hair
a quicker route that saves time

explanation.definitionFit: A short cut is both a drastic trim of hair and a quicker route that saves time.

clue.text: Dog's dark patch

definitions.meaning: to dog someone is to follow them closely, as a tail does
an area of darkness cast where light is blocked

explanation.definitionFit: To shadow is to follow closely like a dog, and a shadow is a dark patch where light is blocked.

clue.text: Thought of French freedom

parts.note: de is French for of
liberation means freedom

explanation.surface: A reflection on French liberty.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberation is careful consideration, which is thought.

clue.text: Group involved in sheltering wild canine

indicators.note: wild suggests letters running out of control and into a new order

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people

explanation.surface: A pack of dogs is sheltering an untamed animal among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges SET (Group) together with SHELTERING; 'involved in' just joins the two parts of the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: The English setter is a breed of gun dog, so it is a canine.

clue.text: Historical goal of running mates?

parts.note: running mates are not political partners but eloping couples, who historically ran off to a Scottish border village to wed

explanation.definitionFit: Gretna Green, just over the Scottish border, was where eloping English couples went to marry without parental consent.

clue.text: Created excitement revealed as sham, over time

indicators.note: over has the sham word spread over the time letter

parts.note: simulated means faked or sham

explanation.surface: Something exciting was revealed to be a fake once time passed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is a container signal here: SIMULATED is laid over T, giving S-T-IMULATED.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stimulated something is to have aroused it, creating excitement.

clue.text: Quietly put suggestive question as advocate in court

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
a barrister who leads a witness asks a question that suggests the desired reply

explanation.surface: A lawyer softly asks a leading question while arguing a case.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawyers plead a case, presenting it in court on a client's behalf, which is to advocate.

clue.text: Rex in silly Irish hat — one's ashamed to wear it

indicators.note: in places one letter inside the rearranged group
silly signals the letters are jumbled foolishly

parts.note: R is short for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king wears a ridiculous Irish hat and someone feels embarrassed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'silly' rearranges the eight letters of 'Irish hat', and 'in' lodges the king's letter among them. The definition is the whole closing phrase: a penitent's garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A penitent wore a rough garment of goat hair as self-punishment, out of shame for sins.

clue.text: Special language one's associating with East?

definitions.text: Special language one's associating with East?

parts.note: cant is the jargon of a particular group
taken as written, ONE'S
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A question about which tongue people link with the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: a language people associate with the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Cantonese is a Chinese language spoken in southern China and Hong Kong, in the Far East.

clue.text: No car in America contains this instrument

indicators.note: contains shows the words hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: A claim that a phrase about cars in the US holds a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument of terracotta.

clue.text: Old man of Paris I found in first carriage

indicators.note: found in places one letter inside the carriage word

parts.note: a baby's pram is the first carriage anyone rides in

explanation.surface: An elderly Parisian man finds me in a vintage railway coach.
explanation.walkthrough: Paris here is the Trojan prince, not the French city: his father was King Priam of Troy.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, King Priam of Troy was father to Paris; 'old man' is slang for father.

clue.text: Cooking device for person who steals food

definitions.meaning: a pan for gently simmering eggs or fish
someone who hunts game illegally on another's land

explanation.definitionFit: A poacher is both a pan for poaching eggs and someone who illegally takes game.

clue.text: Benevolent spirit of investor, on paper

indicators.note: in an across clue on means the first piece comes after the second

parts.note: the Guardian is a British national newspaper
an angel is a backer who funds a theatre production

explanation.surface: A kindly financier exists only in the paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A guardian angel is a protective spirit watching over someone, benevolent by nature.

clue.text: Engaged in work at the highest level

parts.note: at means engaged in, as in 'at work'
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone busy at a job in a top position.
explanation.definitionFit: Atop means on top of something, at its highest point.

clue.text: Member of family briefly follows the argument

indicators.note: follows puts the family member after the word the

parts.note: sis is a shortening of sister

explanation.surface: A sibling in a hurry goes along with the debate.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesis is a proposition put forward and argued for, so it is an argument.

clue.text: Most enjoyable part of euphoric states produced by drug

parts.note: highs are moods of great elation
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A drug-induced rush is the best bit of the experience.
explanation.definitionFit: A high spot is the best moment or highlight of an event.

clue.text: Leave with uncle and father

definitions.meaning: to ... out or ... off is to leave briefly
uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker

explanation.definitionFit: Pop means to nip out, to pawn at uncle's (the pawnbroker), and is a familiar word for dad.

clue.text: Foreign correspondent, perhaps, engaged in friendly exchanges

definitions.meaning: someone abroad you write letters to
a friend kept through letters back and forth

explanation.definitionFit: A pen pal is a friend, often abroad, with whom one exchanges friendly letters.

clue.text: Change I printed in bold

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters

explanation.surface: An instruction to alter something printed in a heavy typeface.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' rearranges I PRINTED; 'in' is a link. The surface's 'bold' is typography, but here it means brave.
explanation.definitionFit: Intrepid means fearless and daring, a synonym of bold.
